PATIENT PORTAL MESSAGE (from patient) Sent: 07/05/2070 21:40 To: Blue Mountain Women's Health - Dr. Aalto Subject: IUD check
hi dr aalto, its amaris frost. i had the new IUD put in on the 2nd and since then ive had cramps that wake me up and some spotting. is that normal?? the last one i had took a few weeks to settle. no fever. i work from home so i can come in anytime this week.

--- reply from Joy (RN care coordinator) 07/06/2070 --- Hi Amaris! Cramping and light spotting are common in the first few weeks. Please call if you have fever, heavy bleeding, or severe pain. We have you down for a string check in 4-6 weeks. :)
